# My Agent

My agent takes the most updated version of the app and attempts to add 5 new features from the Roadmap to the app, and place it in a new branch. Do not update the main branch. Give the set of features a name that encompasses all the features. It can be fun and kooky--just a reference to anything they all have in common.
